messages:
anya: Quick privacy check — support flagged a prod log that may contain user emails after the feature-toggle rollback. Can we scope exposure and decide comms?

kevin: Which bucket/path? I can check ACLs and who has access.

anya: s3://redwood-logs/prod/serving/2026-03-17/req-abc123.log
Snippet: ```
ERROR handler: failed processing request user_id=usr_456 user_email=jane.doe@example.com trace_id=tr-9f8g7
Stack: ...
```

security-bot: Automated scan detected PII pattern (PII_EMAIL) in 1 file. Flagged for review.

maria: Do we know how many people/roles can read that bucket? Any external contractors?

kevin: Only infra and SRE roles normally. Two engineers had temporary access via access request #AP-1234 (contractor=no). I'll revoke now and run an access audit.

pete: I'll run a grep for email regex across last 48h and report counts. Will also check error-reporting sinks (Sentry, Datadog).

kevin: Revoked temp access at 1763270800. Starting redaction job to replace email strings with <REDACTED_EMAIL>.

pete: Scan results: 24 occurrences across 3 files, all under the same canary prefix. No matches in Sentry or public error streams. Files: 
- prod/serving/2026-03-17/req-abc123.log
- prod/serving/2026-03-16/req-xyz987.log
- prod/canary/2026-03-17/req-canary-44.log

maria: Proposed next steps: 1) revoke outstanding access (kevin done), 2) redact files (kevin running), 3) audit and document, 4) legal review to decide on customer comms. Timeline?

kevin: Redaction job completed at 1763270900 — 3 files overwritten with redacted copies, original object moved to internal-archive with restricted ACLs. Checksums updated.

anya: Thanks. @sarah-legal can you confirm whether this needs external disclosure? My read: internal-only logs, no customer data shared externally.

sarah-legal: If it’s confined to internal S3 and not shared externally, we do not need customer notifications. Please ensure we keep an auditable trail: access logs, redaction job logs, ticket linking. Also document mitigation and preventative actions.

ops-bot: Holding scheduled log transfers to third-party analytics until manual review cleared.

pete: Re-ran grep — 0 matches now. Verified with a time-bounded regex and checksum compare.

maria: Good. Action items: rotate dev/service account keys that had been used for the temporary access; add a lint rule to scrub emails at ingest; add monitoring alert for PII regex in logs. Assign owners?

kevin: I’ll rotate service account keys and add ACL enforcement. ETA 2h.

anya: I’ll draft internal incident memo for the org and attach the timeline + artifacts. Will schedule a short post-incident review. :white_check_mark:

maria: Closing the urgent task here. Please add follow-ups to the incident ticket and tag security for the PIi prevention work. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
